messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — pentest window is locked in for Apr 15-17. I need final confirmation on RBAC changes, KMS access model for assessors, and audit-log retention before we hand over. Who can own the access matrix?
liam: I can own RBAC mapping. Will need the exact list of principals and timeboxed roles. Can we get the assessor AWS/IDP identifiers?
maya: Yes — vendor provided SAML IDs, sending in a DM. Key asks: 1) ephemeral decrypt for evidence packaging, 2) read-only access to audit logs (no writes), 3) no access to customer data buckets.
jordan: For KMS we should proxy decrypts via the KMS-proxy service so we never give raw kms:Decrypt to third-party principals. Proposed pattern: create an ephemeral role that can call our proxy endpoint `POST /assessor/decrypt` which logs the request and returns plaintext only to the assessor session.
liam: Sounds good. Two requests: add explicit log retention tag so audit export includes assessor activity, and a short TTL on the ephemeral role (max 6 hours).
maya: Agreed on TTL. Ops, can you set up the proxy policy? Example policy snippet for the ephemeral role:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-ephemeral"}
  ]
}
```
ops-oncall: I’ll carve out a temporary role and attach a permissions boundary. Will schedule creation April 14. Will also enable CloudTrail insight for the assessor principal.
sam: FYI — Compliance wants 90-day retention for the audit exports for this engagement. Is that compatible with our S3 lifecycle?
jordan: 90 days ok. We'll tag exports `pentest=acme-2026-04` and apply a lifecycle rule to move to cold storage after 30 days, delete after 90.
liam: Regarding remediation tracking — we should use the existing vuln-tracker board but add a `pentest-2026` label and an SLA field. Proposed SLA: fixes classified P1 within 5 business days, P2 within 15. Thoughts?
maya: Good. Also, test evidence requirements: for each vulnerability we need reproducer steps, logs (redwood-app + infra), and proof of fix (config diff + retest notes). Put that in the ticket template.
security-bot: Reminder: create a read-only evidence bucket and pre-signed upload link for assessors. Command: `./deploy/evidence_bucket.sh --create --ttl 7d --prefix pentest/acme-2026`
ops-oncall: Created role `assessor-ephemeral` in dev/staging now; prod will be created April 14 as planned. Evidence bucket pre-signed flow wired to the proxy.
maya: OK — last item: retest slots. Vendor asked for two retest days (ASAP after fixes). Can we reserve Apr 22-23 (week after) for retest window?
liam: Tentatively blocked those on the SRE calendar. If fixes slip we'll push to Apr 29-30. Keep the vendor updated.
maya: Great — owners: liam for RBAC/tickets, jordan for KMS/proxy, ops-oncall for infra + evidence bucket, sam for compliance retention. I’ll send a follow-up DM with the assessor IDs and the ticket template. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
security-bot: Action items created: #RBAC-mapping (liam), #KMS-proxy-deploy (jordan), #evidence-bucket (ops-oncall), #compliance-retention (sam).
liam: Will open the pentest label in vuln-tracker and import current findings to baseline.
